review_candidates.title: Senior Product Analyst
review_candidates.description: About Bosta: Launched in 2017, Bosta is an overnight delivery provider for E-commerce companies in Egypt. Leveraging technology to empower businesses is what we do best. Our goal is to disrupt the logistics industry by bringing technology and experience altogether to provide a one-stop-shop for delivery solutions. We rely on advanced technology to deliver orders to our customers in a fast way. Businesses can track and connect with couriers and follow up on their orders - all in one system. Job Code: 2025DATA-037 Job Overview: As Product Analytics Lead, you will be the Product team’s embedded analytics partner — the analytics arm behind every launch, iteration, and product change. You will jointly define success metrics with PMs before features ship, instrument and measure their impact after they do, and own the Tableau dashboards that give Product leadership constant visibility on what is working and what is not. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy and data: translating product questions into rigorous analyses, and analyses into clear product decisions. Job Responsibilities: 1- Product Performance Partnership: Serve as the embedded analytics partner for the Product team across every launch, A/B test, feature tweak, and product modification. Define success metrics, target thresholds, and guardrail metrics with PMs before launch — not after. Run pre-launch sizing, post-launch impact reads, and ongoing performance reviews on every shipped change. Proactively surface product opportunities by digging into adoption gaps, friction points, and behavioral patterns. 2- Experimentation & Causal Inference: Design and analyze A/B tests, switchbacks, and quasi-experiments. Own the experimentation rigor bar — sample size, MDE, segment cuts, novelty and network effects. Apply best-practice methods (matched pairs, difference-in-differences, regression adjustment) where randomization is not feasible. Communicate results with clear effect sizes, confidence intervals, and recommended decisions — not just p-values. 3- Tableau Dashboards & Self-Serve Visibility: Build and maintain the Tableau dashboards that give Product leadership real-time visibility on every active product, feature, and experiment. Design dashboards around the questions PMs actually ask — funnels, cohorts, retention curves, segment splits — not generic vanity metrics. Apply visualization best practices so insights are legible at a glance and decision-ready. 4- SQL & Data Foundations: Write production-grade SQL against Bosta’s warehouse to extract, transform, and analyze product event and outcome data. Partner with data engineering to ensure clean, reliable instrumentation lands with new features — not retrofitted weeks later. Maintain definitions, metric lineage, and documentation for all product KPIs. 5- Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineering across the full product lifecycle — discovery, scoping, launch, iteration. Translate ambiguous product questions into analytical workstreams, and analytical findings into product action. Brief leadership on product performance at the right altitude — strategic for execs, tactical for PMs. 6- Best Practice & Craft: Bring and embed product analytics best practices — funnels, cohorts, activation, retention, north-star frameworks, leading vs. lagging indicators. Stay current on the product analytics craft (Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog patterns, growth analytics literature) and bring relevant techniques into the team. Foster a data-driven culture inside the Product org — equipping PMs to read and reason about their own data. Job Requirements: Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or similar). 4–6 years of analytics experience, with at least 2–3 years specifically in product analytics, partnering directly with Product teams. Demonstrated track record across full product launch cycles — pre-launch design, instrumentation, A/B testing, post-launch impact reads. Strong proficiency in SQL — able to write complex, performant queries against production warehouses independently. Hands-on Tableau experience building and maintaining dashboards for non-technical product audiences. (Power BI / Looker considered if Tableau ramp-up is fast.) Solid grounding in experimentation methodology and product analytics best practices (funnels, cohorts, retention, north-star metrics). Python proficiency for analysis, automation, and statistical work. Strong business acumen and the ability to translate product questions into rigorous analytical solutions — and analytical results back into clear product recommendations. Tech startup/marketplace / logistics-product experience is a strong plus. Excellent stakeholder communication — equally comfortable with PMs, engineers, and execs. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Applied AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: Applied AI Engineer Remote | $180,000–$210,000 base + equity | Full-time | 2 openings Location: US-based preferred Offsites: Twice per year Experience: 8–10 years Work authorization: Candidates must have their own US work authorization About the Company This profitable, seed-stage career technology company is on a mission to give everyone access to great coaching. The company has built a curated network of experienced operator-coaches who work with managers and leaders at some of the world's leading technology companies. Around the human coaching relationship, the company is building a powerful software and AI layer capturing what is happening at work, giving coaches better context, and helping members turn coaching insights into meaningful action between sessions. The result is an AI-native, human-centered challenger to the traditional coaching model, operating as a remote-first company across the US, Canada, and Latin America. About the Role We're looking for a product-minded full-stack engineer who knows how to put AI into the hands of real users. This is not an ML research, data science, or pure data engineering role. The focus is on building useful AI-powered product experiences and shipping them into production. You'll join a small, highly experienced engineering team and work closely with the founders, product, design, and coaching network. The two qualities that matter most are: 1. Exceptional AI development workflow You know how to use modern AI coding tools effectively and, importantly, how to validate, test, automate, and improve their output. This will be assessed through a live LLM coding interview. 2. Critical thinking You can clearly explain the technical decisions you've made, build a strong mental model of complex systems, and articulate what you would change with hindsight. What You'll Own Build and ship AI-powered features used by real customers Develop full-stack product experiences around foundation models Build data pipelines and search/indexing systems Work across Go, TypeScript, Ruby, and other technologies as needed Design and implement event-driven systems Collaborate directly with founders, product, design, and the coaching network Make pragmatic technical decisions and move quickly from idea to production Help shape the team's approach to AI-assisted software development What We're Looking For Approximately 8–10 years of professional experience, with strong hands-on engineering ability. Ideal candidates will have: Senior-level full-stack or software engineering experience A strong track record of shipping AI features to real users Server-side web development experience Comfort working with dynamic programming languages Experience with data pipelines and search indexes Ability to adapt quickly across different technology stacks Experience with event-driven architectures Strong startup experience and a high level of ownership Excellent critical thinking and communication skills A genuine interest in building products rather than simply researching technology Strong Backgrounds We're particularly interested in: Founders and founding engineers Startup engineers who have shipped AI-powered features Engineers who have worked with transcripts or large-document AI Experience with legal, regulatory, or tax text Coaching, learning, or HR technology Senior engineers from larger companies who are ready to return to a highly hands-on role The team is looking for ambitious but fun "happy warriors", people who take their work seriously without taking themselves too seriously. Tech Environment The current stack includes: Go TypeScript Ruby Event-driven architecture Data pipelines and search/indexing infrastructure Modern AI and LLM tooling You don't need to have worked with every technology listed. Adaptability and strong engineering fundamentals matter more. What This Role Is Not This is unlikely to be a fit for: Pure ML, data science, or research profiles Data engineers applying for an "AI" title without product experience Candidates whose background is exclusively Big Tech and consulting New graduates or engineers still developing their core engineering experience Pure mobile or embedded engineers Agency profiles where AI has only been a small part of the work Candidates uncomfortable challenging assumptions or disagreeing constructively with founders Location & Work Authorization The role is fully remote, but candidates should ideally be based in the United States with their own work authorization. The team meets in person for offsites twice per year. Interview Process The process focuses heavily on real-world engineering ability and how you think. Expect to discuss: AI features you've shipped to production Your technical decision-making and trade-offs Your AI coding workflow and how you validate AI-generated code Your startup experience and end-to-end ownership A live LLM coding interview is included in the process. If you're a senior engineer who wants to stay hands-on, build meaningful AI products, and work closely with an experienced founding team, this is an opportunity to have significant impact from day one.
